svg.title: Software factory: from prompts to merge
svg.desc: A staggered isometric software workflow with illustrative efficiency metrics: average dollars per stage execution and the percentage of executions needing rework. Green means cost is within the stage budget and rework is at most 10 percent. Yellow means cost is up to 1.5 times budget or rework is up to 25 percent. Red means either cost exceeds 1.5 times budget or rework exceeds 25 percent. The worse metric sets stage color. Build and Review have blinking red indicators. All three feedback loops are labeled with their source stage rework rate and colored by that rework rate. Values and budgets are examples, not live telemetry. Reduced motion keeps all red warnings steadily visible.

g.aria-label: Prompts: $0.03 per execution, 2 percent rework, On target
Think: $0.17 per execution, 14 percent rework, Watch
Explore: $0.18 per execution, 6 percent rework, On target
Build: $0.98 per execution, 31 percent rework, Inefficient
Verify: $0.28 per execution, 18 percent rework, Watch
Review: $0.21 per execution, 29 percent rework, Inefficient
Merge: $0.02 per execution, 1 percent rework, On target
